1	# Business Requirements Document: Credit Control
2	
3	| | |
4	|---|---|
5	| Prepared for | Finance Director |
6	| Prepared by | Business Analyst, Finance |
7	| Version | 1.0 (draft for sign-off) |
8	| Status | For review by Finance, Sales and IT |
9	
10	## 1. Purpose
11	
12	This document sets out what the business needs from a credit control capability in our ERP system. Today credit control lives in a spreadsheet and in the head of our credit controller. The board has asked that it move into the ERP, so that the same rules are applied to every customer every time, so that sales staff and customers cannot get around them, and so that our auditors can see what was decided, by whom and when.
13	
14	The document describes the business behaviour we want. It does not say how the software should be built.
15	
16	## 2. Background
17	
18	We are a wholesale distributor with about 900 trade customers on account. Customers are billed in several currencies. Orders reach us in four main ways: entered by our sales office, placed by customers through our web shop, sent to us electronically by larger customers, and raised automatically from standing monthly orders.
19	
20	Last financial year our bad debt write-offs were well above what the board considers acceptable. A review found the main causes were:
21	
22	- Customers kept being supplied after they had stopped paying, because the "stop list" was a spreadsheet that the sales office and the web shop did not check.
23	- Credit limits were set once when the account was opened and rarely looked at again.
24	- Reminder letters were sent irregularly, depending on how busy the credit controller was.
25	- We charged no interest or late fees, so slow payers had no reason to pay on time.
26	- Write-offs were posted inconsistently, and at year end the auditors had trouble matching the sales ledger to the general ledger and to the decisions behind each write-off.
27	
28	We already use the ERP for sales orders, invoicing, customer accounts, statements and the general ledger, so the credit control work should sit there too.
29	
30	## 3. Stakeholders
31	
32	| Stakeholder | Interest |
33	|---|---|
34	| Finance Director (sponsor) | Lower bad debt, consistent control, a clean audit. |
35	| Maria, Credit Controller | Runs credit control day to day: reviews, stops, reminders, charges, write-offs. |
36	| Deputy Credit Controller | Covers for Maria with the same authority. |
37	| Financial Accountant | Month-end close; the ledger must agree with customer accounts. |
38	| Sales Manager and sales reps | Need to know which of their customers are on stop or on watch; must not be able to override it. |
39	| Sales office / order entry | Must be stopped from processing orders for customers on stop. |
40	| Customers | See their own reminders, interest and fees; receive reminder letters by email. |
41	| External auditors | Need a trail of credit decisions, charges and write-offs. |
42	| IT / system administrator | Installs and configures the change on our live system. |
43	
44	## 4. Scope
45	
46	### 4.1 In scope
47	
48	1. Periodic credit reviews of customers, recording the outcome, notes and the next review date.
49	2. Putting customers "on stop" (also called "on hold" or "frozen") and taking them off stop.
50	3. A softer "watch" status for customers we are worried about but still supply.
51	4. Overdue reminder letters ("chasers", "dunning letters") in escalating stages, sent by email.
52	5. Interest and/or late fees on overdue balances, charged at month end.
53	6. Writing off bad debts.
54	7. A report of customers due a credit review and customers over their credit limit.
55	8. Sales reps seeing only their own customers' credit information.
56	9. Customers seeing their own reminders and charges in the customer portal.
57	10. Month-end agreement between the general ledger and customer accounts.
58	11. Working on both our existing live system and on any new installation.
59	12. Updating the staff guide.
60	
61	### 4.2 Out of scope
62	
63	- Credit insurance and external credit-reference agency feeds.
64	- Debt collection agencies and legal proceedings (we will continue to handle these outside the system, though we want a note of them against the customer).
65	- Changes to how customers pay us, or to cash allocation.
66	- Customer credit applications and account opening.
67	- Supplier (purchase ledger) side.
68	- Changes to price lists, discounts or sales commissions.
69	
70	## 5. Business Requirements
71	
72	### 5.1 Credit reviews
73	
74	- **BR-01** Credit control must be able to record a credit review against any customer. A review records the date, who did it, the outcome (for example: limit confirmed, limit raised, limit reduced, put on watch, put on stop), any new credit limit, free-text notes and the next review date.
75	- **BR-02** Every customer on account must have a next review date. New customers get one automatically when their account is opened, based on a standard review period set by Finance (we expect 12 months, and shorter for higher-risk customers).
76	- **BR-03** The full history of reviews for a customer must be kept and viewable. Past reviews cannot be changed or deleted.
77	- **BR-04** When a review changes the credit limit, the customer's limit must update as part of the review, so the limit and the reason for it are always recorded together.
78	
79	### 5.2 Stop and watch
80	
81	- **BR-05** Credit control must be able to put a customer on stop, with a reason, and take them off stop, with a reason. Each change records who did it and when.
82	- **BR-06** While a customer is on stop, no new orders may be accepted or released for them, by any route: the sales office, the web shop, electronic orders and standing monthly orders. Goods must not be dispatched or invoiced on existing orders taken before the stop, unless credit control releases them.
83	- **BR-07** Only the credit controller and the deputy (and the Finance Director) may put customers on or off stop, or change credit limits. Sales reps and sales office staff must not be able to.
84	- **BR-08** Credit control must be able to put a customer on "watch". A customer on watch can still be supplied, but anyone taking an order for them must be clearly warned, and credit control should be able to see orders taken for watched customers.
85	- **BR-09** A customer's credit status (normal, watch or on stop) must be clearly visible wherever staff look at that customer or take an order for them.
86	- **BR-10** Orders that would take a customer over their credit limit must be held for credit control's approval rather than accepted outright. (Today reps "just put it through".)
87	- **BR-11** Where a customer has asked for or been told about a stop, the customer should see in the web shop that their account is on hold and should contact us, rather than having orders silently fail.
88	
89	### 5.3 Reminder letters (dunning)
90	
91	- **BR-12** The system must send overdue reminder letters in escalating stages. We expect three stages to start with: a polite reminder, a firmer second letter, and a final notice warning that the account will be put on stop and charges applied. Finance must be able to set the number of stages, how many days overdue triggers each stage and the wording of each letter.
92	- **BR-13** Reminders must go by email to the customer's accounts contact. Customers with no email address must be listed so that credit control can post the letter.
93	- **BR-14** Reminders are produced in a regular run (we expect weekly) started by credit control. Before sending, credit control must be able to see who will get which letter and leave out particular customers (for example, where a payment has been promised or there is a dispute).
94	- **BR-15** A customer should only move up a stage if they are still overdue; a customer who pays must not get the next letter. A customer must not receive the same stage twice in a short time.
95	- **BR-16** Every reminder sent must be recorded against the customer: the date, the stage, what invoices it covered and the amount.
96	- **BR-17** Reminders must be in the customer's own currency and show their overdue invoices.
97	- **BR-18** Credit control should be able to mark an invoice as disputed, so that it is not chased and not charged interest until the dispute is settled.
98	
99	### 5.4 Interest and late fees
100	
101	- **BR-19** At month end the system must be able to charge interest on overdue balances, a fixed late fee, or both. Finance must be able to set the interest rate, the fee amount and how many days overdue a balance must be before it is charged.
102	- **BR-20** It must be possible to exempt individual customers from interest and/or fees (for example, key accounts or those with agreed payment plans).
103	- **BR-21** Charges must be raised in the customer's own currency and must appear on the customer's account and their next statement as separate, clearly described items.
104	- **BR-22** Before charges are posted, credit control must be able to see a list of what will be charged to whom, and confirm it. The same month must not be charged twice.
105	- **BR-23** Interest and fees must post to the general ledger to the income accounts that Finance chooses.
106	- **BR-24** Credit control must be able to waive (reverse) a charge for a customer, with a reason, and the reversal must also reach the ledger.
107	
108	### 5.5 Bad debt write-off
109	
110	- **BR-25** Credit control must be able to write off all or part of a customer's unpaid balance as a bad debt, with a reason.
111	- **BR-26** Write-offs above an amount set by Finance must be approved by the Finance Director before they take effect.
112	- **BR-27** A write-off must reduce the customer's balance and post to the bad debt account in the general ledger, including any currency difference.
113	- **BR-28** When a customer has a debt written off, the customer should be put on stop automatically, unless credit control decides otherwise.
114	- **BR-29** There must be a report of write-offs over a period, showing customer, amount, reason, who did it and who approved it.
115	
116	### 5.6 Reporting
117	
118	- **BR-30** A credit control report must list customers who are due or overdue for a credit review, customers over their credit limit (and by how much), and customers on watch or on stop. It must be filterable by sales rep and by currency, and totals must be shown in our home currency.
119	- **BR-31** The aged debt report must show each customer's credit status, credit limit and the last reminder stage sent.
120	- **BR-32** All credit control actions (reviews, stop/watch changes, limit changes, reminders, charges, waivers and write-offs) must be visible as a history per customer that the auditors can inspect.
121	
122	### 5.7 Sales reps
123	
124	- **BR-33** Sales reps must see credit information (status, limit, balance, overdue amounts, reminders) only for their own customers, not for other reps' customers.
125	- **BR-34** Reps can see but not change credit status or limits.
126	
127	### 5.8 Customer portal
128	
129	- **BR-35** Customers who log in to the portal must be able to see the reminder letters we have sent them and the interest and fees charged to their account, along with their balance.
130	- **BR-36** A customer must only ever see their own account.
131	
132	### 5.9 Month end and the ledger
133	
134	- **BR-37** At month end the total of all customer balances must agree with the trade debtors control account in the general ledger, after interest, fees, waivers and write-offs have been posted.
135	- **BR-38** If they do not agree, Finance must be able to find out why from the system.
136	
137	### 5.10 Installation and rollout
138	
139	- **BR-39** The capability must work on our existing live system, with all our existing customers, balances and history, as well as on a brand-new installation.
140	- **BR-40** On go-live every existing customer starts as "normal", with a next review date set by Finance, unless credit control loads their current status from the spreadsheet. Existing customers who are on the spreadsheet stop list today must be on stop in the system from day one.
141	- **BR-41** Nothing in the new capability should change how existing invoices, statements or postings behave for customers who are not overdue.
142	
143	### 5.11 Documentation and training
144	
145	- **BR-42** The staff guide must be updated to explain credit reviews, stop and watch, the reminder run, month-end charges, write-offs and the credit control report.
146	- **BR-43** Sales staff need a short note on what "watch" and "stop" mean for them and who to contact.
147	
148	## 6. User Stories
149	
150	1. **As Maria (credit controller)**, I want to see every Monday which customers are due a review or over their limit, so that I can work through them in order and nothing slips.
151	2. **As Maria**, I want to put a customer on stop once, and know that the sales office, the web shop, EDI orders and the standing orders are all blocked, so that I don't have to phone round.
152	3. **As the deputy credit controller**, I want the same powers and the same history as Maria, so that I can cover her holidays without asking her what she agreed with whom.
153	4. **As a sales rep**, I want to see when one of my customers is on watch or on stop, and why, so that I can talk to the customer before they place an order.
154	5. **As Maria**, I want the weekly reminder run to email the right letter at the right stage to each overdue customer, after I've had a chance to take out the ones I'm already talking to.
155	6. **As the Financial Accountant**, I want month-end interest and fees to post themselves to the ledger, so that the debtors control account agrees with the customer balances without manual journals.
156	7. **As the Finance Director**, I want to approve large write-offs before they go through, so that I know what bad debt we are taking.
157	8. **As a customer**, I want to see in the portal the reminders and charges on my account, so that I understand what I owe and why.
158	9. **As the external auditor**, I want to see for any customer who changed their credit limit or status, when and why, so that I can test the credit control process.
159	
160	## 7. Acceptance Criteria (business terms)
161	
162	- **AC-01** Maria records a review on a customer, raising their limit and setting next review in six months. The new limit applies straight away, and the review, with her notes, appears in the customer's history. The customer drops off the "due for review" list and reappears when the next date comes round.
163	- **AC-02** A customer is put on stop. An order for them cannot be completed in the sales office, through the web shop, electronically or from their standing order. When they are taken off stop, orders go through again. Both changes appear in their history with reasons.
164	- **AC-03** A sales rep tries to take a customer off stop or raise a limit and cannot.
165	- **AC-04** A customer on watch places an order: it is accepted, the person taking it sees a warning, and the order shows on credit control's list.
166	- **AC-05** An order that would take a customer over their limit is held and only released when credit control approves it.
167	- **AC-06** In the reminder run, a customer 35 days overdue gets the first letter by email; the next run, if still unpaid and past the second threshold, they get the second letter; if they pay in between, they get nothing. A customer marked disputed gets no letter. Every letter sent shows on the customer's account history and in their portal.
168	- **AC-07** At month end, an overdue customer is charged interest at the set rate and the set late fee in their own currency; an exempt customer is not charged; running the charges again for the same month charges nobody twice. The charges appear on the customer's statement and in the portal.
169	- **AC-08** After month-end charges, waivers and write-offs, the total of customer balances equals the debtors control account in the general ledger.
170	- **AC-09** A write-off below the approval amount reduces the customer's balance and appears in the bad debt account; one above it does nothing until the Finance Director approves it. The customer is put on stop.
171	- **AC-10** Rep A sees credit details for her customers and none for Rep B's customers. Customer X in the portal sees only Customer X's reminders and charges.
172	- **AC-11** After go-live on the live system, all existing customers, balances and history are intact, every customer has a next review date, and everyone on the old spreadsheet stop list is on stop.
173	- **AC-12** The updated staff guide covers every item in section 4.1 and has been read and agreed by Maria and the Sales Manager.
174	
175	## 8. Assumptions
176	
177	- Customers' accounts contact email addresses are mostly up to date; credit control will clean up the rest before go-live.
178	- Each customer already has a single sales rep assigned.
179	- Our terms and conditions allow us to charge interest and late fees; Legal will confirm the wording for letters.
180	- Credit control will provide the current stop list and credit limits from the spreadsheet for go-live.
181	
182	## 9. Open Questions
183	
184	1. Interest: a simple annual rate on overdue balances, or a statutory late-payment rate? Does it differ by currency or country?
185	2. Late fee: one flat fee per month, or a fee per overdue invoice? Should it vary by currency?
186	3. Do we charge interest on interest and fees that are themselves overdue?
187	4. Should a customer be put on stop automatically after the final reminder, or only flagged for Maria to decide?
188	5. How should over-limit orders from the web shop and standing orders be handled: held for approval, or rejected with a message to the customer?
189	6. What is the approval threshold for write-offs, and does the Financial Accountant also need to sign off?
190	7. If a written-off debt is later paid, how do we want it shown?
191	8. Should reps be told the reason for a stop, or only that the customer is on stop?
192	9. Do we need the reminder letters in languages other than English for overseas customers?
193	10. Should customers be able to see "watch" status in the portal? (Our view: no.)
194	11. Who covers credit decisions when both Maria and her deputy are away?
195	12. Do head-office/branch customer groups share one credit limit, or does each branch have its own?

9. **As the external auditor**, I want to see for any customer who changed their credit limit or status, when and why, so that I can test the credit control process.

## 7. Acceptance Criteria (business terms)

- **AC-01** Maria records a review on a customer, raising their limit and setting next review in six months. The new limit applies straight away, and the review, with her notes, appears in the customer's history. The customer drops off the "due for review" list and reappears when the next date comes round.
- **AC-02** A customer is put on stop. An order for them cannot be completed in the sales office, through the web shop, electronically or from their standing order. When they are taken off stop, orders go through again. Both changes appear in their history with reasons.
- **AC-03** A sales rep tries to take a customer off stop or raise a limit and cannot.
- **AC-04** A customer on watch places an order: it is accepted, the person taking it sees a warning, and the order shows on credit control's list.
- **AC-05** An order that would take a customer over their limit is held and only released when credit control approves it.
- **AC-06** In the reminder run, a customer 35 days overdue gets the first letter by email; the next run, if still unpaid and past the second threshold, they get the second letter; if they pay in between, they get nothing. A customer marked disputed gets no letter. Every letter sent shows on the customer's account history and in their portal.
- **AC-07** At month end, an overdue customer is charged interest at the set rate and the set late fee in their own currency; an exempt customer is not charged; running the charges again for the same month charges nobody twice. The charges appear on the customer's statement and in the portal.
- **AC-08** After month-end charges, waivers and write-offs, the total of customer balances equals the debtors control account in the general ledger.
- **AC-09** A write-off below the approval amount reduces the customer's balance and appears in the bad debt account; one above it does nothing until the Finance Director approves it. The customer is put on stop.
- **AC-10** Rep A sees credit details for her customers and none for Rep B's customers. Customer X in the portal sees only Customer X's reminders and charges.
- **AC-11** After go-live on the live system, all existing customers, balances and history are intact, every customer has a next review date, and everyone on the old spreadsheet stop list is on stop.
- **AC-12** The updated staff guide covers every item in section 4.1 and has been read and agreed by Maria and the Sales Manager.

## 8. Assumptions

- Customers' accounts contact email addresses are mostly up to date; credit control will clean up the rest before go-live.
- Each customer already has a single sales rep assigned.
- Our terms and conditions allow us to charge interest and late fees; Legal will confirm the wording for letters.
- Credit control will provide the current stop list and credit limits from the spreadsheet for go-live.

## 9. Open Questions

1. Interest: a simple annual rate on overdue balances, or a statutory late-payment rate? Does it differ by currency or country?
2. Late fee: one flat fee per month, or a fee per overdue invoice? Should it vary by currency?
3. Do we charge interest on interest and fees that are themselves overdue?
4. Should a customer be put on stop automatically after the final reminder, or only flagged for Maria to decide?
5. How should over-limit orders from the web shop and standing orders be handled: held for approval, or rejected with a message to the customer?
6. What is the approval threshold for write-offs, and does the Financial Accountant also need to sign off?
7. If a written-off debt is later paid, how do we want it shown?
8. Should reps be told the reason for a stop, or only that the customer is on stop?
9. Do we need the reminder letters in languages other than English for overseas customers?
10. Should customers be able to see "watch" status in the portal? (Our view: no.)
11. Who covers credit decisions when both Maria and her deputy are away?
12. Do head-office/branch customer groups share one credit limit, or does each branch have its own?

CREATE TABLE `debtortrans` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `type` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `branchcode` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `trandate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `inputdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `prd` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `settled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reference` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `tpe` char(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `order_` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `rate` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ovamount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ovgst` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ovfreight` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ovdiscount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `diffonexch` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `alloc` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `invtext` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `shipvia` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `edisent` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `consignment` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

<?php

//
// Credit status is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason (holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 = stop, 2 = watch).

// late interest and fees, write-offs and the permissions to run them.

// 1. Existing tables

AddColumn('nextreviewdate', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextreviewdate');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');
AddIndex(array('nextreviewdate'), 'debtorsmaster', 'nextreviewdate');

AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'salesperson');

  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `entered` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`reviewid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditreviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)

NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Bad Debt Write-offs'), '/CreditWriteOffs.php', 23);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control'), '/CreditHeldOrders.php', 24);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Report'), '/CreditControlReport.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control History'), '/CreditHistory.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Credit Control Settings'), '/CreditControlSettings.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Reminder Letter Stages'), '/DunningStages.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('Utilities', 'Maintenance', __('Import Customer Credit Status from .csv file'), '/Z_ImportCreditStatus.php', 45);

// 5. Configuration, Finance completes the general ledger accounts in Credit Control Settings

NewConfigValue('CreditReviewMonths', '12');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestRate', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditLateFee', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditChargeDays', '30');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditFeeAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditBadDebtAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditWriteOffThreshold', '1000');
NewConfigValue('CreditReminderGapDays', '14');
NewConfigValue('CreditAutoStopAfterFinal', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditStopHoldReason', '');

// 6. Data

// Hold reasons created with the column default (-1) never blocked anybody in order entry, keep that behaviour
executeSQL("UPDATE holdreasons SET dissallowinvoices=0 WHERE dissallowinvoices<0");

// The business wants over-limit orders held for approval: "do not check" and "warn" become "hold for approval"
// "prohibit" is stricter and stays as it is
executeSQL("UPDATE config SET confvalue='3' WHERE confname='CheckCreditLimits' AND confvalue IN ('0','1')");

// Every existing customer starts with a next review date, Finance can change them or load them from the old spreadsheet
// with Z_ImportCreditStatus.php
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextreviewdate='1000-01-01'");

// Reminder letters: three stages to start with
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(1), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(1, 30, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(2), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(2, 45, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(3), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(3, 60, 1));

InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nOur records show that the following invoices on your account are overdue. This may be an oversight, if you have already paid please ignore this reminder.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease arrange payment at your earliest convenience.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Second reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nWe wrote to you recently about overdue invoices on your account and have not yet received payment. The following invoices remain unpaid.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease pay immediately or contact us to discuss.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'FINAL NOTICE: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nDespite our earlier reminders the following invoices remain unpaid.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nUnless payment is received within 7 days your account will be put on stop, no further orders will be supplied and late payment interest and fees will be charged.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));

UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control'));

"')"; DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'), '', true); } /* Date for the next review of a customer, Finance sets the standard period in months */ function CreditNextReviewDate($Months = 0) { if ($Months <= 0) { $Months = CreditControlSetting('CreditReviewMonths', 12); } return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + (int) $Months, date('j'), date('Y'))); } /* The hold reason to use for an automatic stop, falls back to the first reason that disallows invoices */ function CreditStopReasonCode() { $Code = CreditControlSetting('CreditStopHoldReason', ''); if ($Code !== '') { $Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $Code . <?php

// CREDIT CONTROL
//
// Credit status is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason (holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 = stop, 2 = watch).
// This update adds what is needed around it: review dates, review and action history, reminder letters,
// late interest and fees, write-offs and the permissions to run them.

// 1. Existing tables

AddColumn('nextreviewdate', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextreviewdate');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');
AddIndex(array('nextreviewdate'), 'debtorsmaster', 'nextreviewdate');

AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'salesperson');

AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');
AddIndex(array('creditheld'), 'salesorders', 'creditheld');

// 2. New tables

CreateTable('creditreviews', "CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `reviewid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `oldholdreason` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newholdreason` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `entered` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`reviewid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditreviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditlog', "CREATE TABLE `creditlog` (
  `logid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `eventtype` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reference` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`logid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `eventtype` (`eventtype`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditlog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages', "CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `finalnotice` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`stageno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningtexts', "CREATE TABLE `dunningtexts` (
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `language_id` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_GB.utf8',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`stageno`,`language_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunningtexts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`stageno`) REFERENCES `dunningstages` (`stageno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunninglog', "CREATE TABLE `dunninglog` (
  `dunningid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `senddate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `invoices` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `emailto` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `letter` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dunningid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`,`stageno`),
  KEY `senddate` (`senddate`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunninglog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditcharges', "CREATE TABLE `creditcharges` (
  `chargeid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'interest',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `basis` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `trandate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `waived` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivetransno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `waivedate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `waivereason` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`chargeid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `debtormonthtype` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `chargemonth` (`chargemonth`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditcharges_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditwriteoffs', "CREATE TABLE `creditwriteoffs` (
  `writeoffid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requestdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approvedate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `stopcustomer` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`writeoffid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditwriteoffs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

// 3. Transaction types for the customer account entries

NewSysType(51, 'Customer Late Charge');
NewSysType(52, 'Customer Late Charge Waiver');
NewSysType(53, 'Customer Bad Debt Write-off');

// 4. Security: new tokens, who gets them, pages, menu

NewSecurityToken(21, 'Credit Control');
NewSecurityToken(22, 'Credit Control Write-off Approval');

// Accountant and System Administrator can do credit control, only the System Administrator role approves write-offs
// until the Finance Director's own role is given token 22 in User Roles Maintenance
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22));

NewScript('CreditReview.php', 21);
NewScript('DunningRun.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditCharges.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditWriteOffs.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditHeldOrders.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlReport.php', 2);
NewScript('CreditHistory.php', 1);
NewScript('CreditControlSettings.php', 10);
NewScript('DunningStages.php', 10);
NewScript('Z_ImportCreditStatus.php', 15);

// function NewMenuItem($Link, $Section, $Caption, $URL, $Sequence)
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Credit Review'), '/CreditReview.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Overdue Reminder Run'), '/DunningRun.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Month End Interest and Late Fees'), '/CreditCharges.php', 22);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Bad Debt Write-offs'), '/CreditWriteOffs.php', 23);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control'), '/CreditHeldOrders.php', 24);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Report'), '/CreditControlReport.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control History'), '/CreditHistory.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Credit Control Settings'), '/CreditControlSettings.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Reminder Letter Stages'), '/DunningStages.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('Utilities', 'Maintenance', __('Import Customer Credit Status from .csv file'), '/Z_ImportCreditStatus.php', 45);

// 5. Configuration, Finance completes the general ledger accounts in Credit Control Settings

NewConfigValue('CreditReviewMonths', '12');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestRate', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditLateFee', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditChargeDays', '30');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditFeeAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditBadDebtAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditWriteOffThreshold', '1000');
NewConfigValue('CreditReminderGapDays', '14');
NewConfigValue('CreditAutoStopAfterFinal', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditStopHoldReason', '');

// 6. Data

// Hold reasons created with the column default (-1) never blocked anybody in order entry, keep that behaviour
executeSQL("UPDATE holdreasons SET dissallowinvoices=0 WHERE dissallowinvoices<0");

// The business wants over-limit orders held for approval: "do not check" and "warn" become "hold for approval"
// "prohibit" is stricter and stays as it is
executeSQL("UPDATE config SET confvalue='3' WHERE confname='CheckCreditLimits' AND confvalue IN ('0','1')");

// Every existing customer starts with a next review date, Finance can change them or load them from the old spreadsheet
// with Z_ImportCreditStatus.php
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextreviewdate='1000-01-01'");

// Reminder letters: three stages to start with
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(1), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(1, 30, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(2), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(2, 45, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(3), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(3, 60, 1));

InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nOur records show that the following invoices on your account are overdue. This may be an oversight, if you have already paid please ignore this reminder.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease arrange payment at your earliest convenience.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Second reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nWe wrote to you recently about overdue invoices on your account and have not yet received payment. The following invoices remain unpaid.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease pay immediately or contact us to discuss.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'FINAL NOTICE: overdue account',

UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control'));

<?php

/*

This snippet is used to enter order line items into the cart object:

Used only in: SelectOrderItems.php

The reason that it is in this seperate file is because it is used within a loop to get kitset
items into the cart as well as plain vanilla items outside of the kitset loop
*/

$AlreadyOnThisOrder =0;

if (count($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->LineItems)>0
	AND $_SESSION['SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes']==0){

	foreach ($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->LineItems AS $OrderItem) {

	/* do a loop round the items on the order to see that the item
	is not already on this order */

		if (strcasecmp($OrderItem->StockID, $NewItem)==0) {
			$AlreadyOnThisOrder = 1;
			prnMsg(__('The item') . ' ' . $NewItem . ' ' . __('is already on this order the system is set up to prevent the same item being on the order more than once. However you can change the quantity ordered of the existing line if necessary'));
       		}
	} /* end of the foreach loop to look for preexisting items of the same code */
}

if ($AlreadyOnThisOrder!=1){

    $SQL = "SELECT stockmaster.description,
					stockmaster.longdescription,
					stockmaster.stockid,
					stockmaster.units,
					stockmaster.volume,
					stockmaster.grossweight,
					stockmaster. actualcost AS standardcost,
					locstock.quantity,
					stockmaster.mbflag,
					stockmaster.discountcategory,
					stockmaster.decimalplaces,
					stockmaster.discontinued,
					stockmaster.serialised,
					stockmaster.eoq,
					stockmaster.nextserialno,
					stockmaster.taxcatid
			FROM stockmaster INNER JOIN locstock
			ON stockmaster.stockid=locstock.stockid
			WHERE locstock.loccode='" . $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->Location . "'
			AND stockmaster.stockid = '". $NewItem . "'";

    $ErrMsg = __('The details for') . ' ' . $NewItem . ' ' . __('could not be retrieved because');
    $Result1 = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg);

    if (DB_num_rows($Result1)==0){
		prnMsg(__('The item code') . ' ' . $NewItem  . ' '  . __('could not be found in the database') . ' - ' . __('it has not been added to the order'),'warn',__('Item Does Not Exist'));

    } elseif ($MyItemRow = DB_fetch_array($Result1)){

    	if ($MyItemRow['discontinued']==1){
			prnMsg(__('The item') . ' ' . $NewItem . ' ' . __('could not be added to the order because it has been flagged as obsolete'),'error',__('Obsolete Item'));
			include('includes/footer.php');
			exit();
		} elseif (($_SESSION['AllowSalesOfZeroCostItems'] == false
						AND $MyItemRow['standardcost']>0
						AND ($MyItemRow['mbflag']=='B'
						OR $MyItemRow['mbflag']=='M'))
					OR ($_SESSION['AllowSalesOfZeroCostItems'] == false
						AND ($MyItemRow['mbflag']=='A'
						OR $MyItemRow['mbflag']=='D'
						OR $MyItemRow['mbflag']=='K'))
					OR $_SESSION['AllowSalesOfZeroCostItems']==true) {

		/*these checks above ensure that the item has a cost if the
		config.php variable AllowSalesOfZeroCostItems is set to false */

		   	if ($_SESSION['ExistingOrder' . $identifier]!=0){
				$UpdateDB = 'Yes';
				$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(orderlineno) AS newlineno FROM salesorderdetails WHERE orderno='" . $_SESSION['ExistingOrder' . $identifier] . "'");
				$MaxNumRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				if ($MaxNumRow[0] != '' AND $MaxNumRow[0] >= 0) {
					$NewLineNo = $MaxNumRow[0]+1;
				} else {
					$NewLineNo = 0;
				}
			} else {
				$UpdateDB = 'No';
				$NewLineNo = -1; /* this is ok b/c CartClass will change to the correct line no */
			}

			if (isset($StockItem) AND $MyItemRow['discountcategory'] != '' ){
				$DiscCatsDone[$Counter]=$StockItem->DiscCat;
				$QuantityOfDiscCat =0;
				$Result = DB_query("SELECT MAX(discountrate) AS discount
										FROM discountmatrix
										WHERE salestype='" .  $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DefaultSalesType . "'
										AND discountcategory ='" . $MyRow['discountcategory'] . "'
										AND quantitybreak <" . $NewItemQty);
				$DiscCatRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				if ($DiscCatRow[0] != '' AND $DiscCatRow[0] > 0) {
					$Discount = $DiscCatRow[0];
				} else {
					$Discount = 0;
				}
			} elseif (!isset($Discount)){
				$Discount = 0;
			}

			$Price = GetPrice($NewItem, $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DebtorNo,$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->Branch, $NewItemQty);

			/* Need to check for sell through support deals */

			$SQL = "SELECT rebateamount/rate AS rebateinfunctionalcurrency,
							rebatepercent
					FROM sellthroughsupport INNER JOIN suppliers
						ON suppliers.supplierid=sellthroughsupport.supplierno
					INNER JOIN currencies
						ON currencies.currabrev=suppliers.currcode
					WHERE stockid='" . $NewItem . "'
					AND (debtorno='" . $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DebtorNo . "'
						OR debtorno='')
					AND effectivefrom <= CURRENT_DATE
					AND effectiveto >= CURRENT_DATE";
			$SellSuppResult = DB_query($SQL);
			$SellSupportDiscount = 0;
			$SellSupportPercent = 0;
			/*Only the highest discount is taken - it is not accumulated ? */
			if (DB_num_rows($SellSuppResult) > 0){
				while ($SellSupportRow = DB_fetch_array($SellSuppResult)){
					if ($SellSupportRow['rebatepercent'] > $SellSupportPercent){
						$SellSupportPercent = $SellSupportRow['rebatepercent'];
					}
					if ($SellSupportRow['rebateinfunctionalcurrency'] > $SellSupportAmount){
						$SellSupportDiscount = $SellSupportRow['rebateinfunctionalcurrency'];
					}
				}
			}

			/* Sell support can also be specified by stock category */

			$SQL = "SELECT rebateamount/rate AS rebateinfunctionalcurrency,
							rebatepercent
					FROM sellthroughsupport INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON sellthroughsupport.categoryid=stockmaster.categoryid
					INNER JOIN suppliers
					ON suppliers.supplierid=sellthroughsupport.supplierno
					INNER JOIN currencies
					ON currencies.currabrev=suppliers.currcode
					WHERE stockmaster.stockid='" . $NewItem . "'
					AND (debtorno='" . $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DebtorNo . "'
						OR debtorno='')
					AND effectivefrom <= CURRENT_DATE
					AND effectiveto >= CURRENT_DATE";
			$SellSuppResult = DB_query($SQL);
			/*Only the highest discount is taken - it is not accumulated ? */
			if (DB_num_rows($SellSuppResult) > 0){
				while ($SellSupportRow = DB_fetch_array($SellSuppResult)){
					if ($SellSupportRow['rebatepercent'] > $SellSupportPercent){
						$SellSupportPercent = $SellSupportRow['rebatepercent'];
					}
					if ($SellSupportRow['rebateinfunctionalcurrency'] > $SellSupportDiscount){
						$SellSupportDiscount = $SellSupportRow['rebateinfunctionalcurrency'];
					}
				}
			}
			if ($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DefaultCurrency != $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault'] AND $SellSupportDiscount != 0) {
				/* Customer currency is not the same as the functional/home currency so need to convert the rebate amount */
				/* Would be better to have the currency rate held in the cart object so only have to run this query once - this is a hack for this purpose! */
				$CurrResult = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->DefaultCurrency . "'");
				$CurrRow = DB_fetch_array($CurrResult);
				$SellSupportDiscount *= $CurrRow['rate'];
			}
			/*Convert the Sell through support discount to a percentage and add it to the $SellSupportPercent */
			if ($Price > 0){
				$SellSupportPercent += ($SellSupportDiscount/$Price);
			}
			if ($SellSupportPercent >0){
				$Discount += $SellSupportPercent; //combine any discount matrix discount with the sell through support.
				prnMsg(__('Sell through support available and applied of') . ' ' . locale_number_format($SellSupportPercent*100,2), 'info');
			}

			$WithinCreditLimit = true;

			if ($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->SpecialInstructions) {
			  	prnMsg($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->SpecialInstructions,'warn');
            }
			if ($_SESSION['CheckCreditLimits'] > 0 AND $AlreadyWarnedAboutCredit==false){
				/*Check credit limits is 1 for warn	and 2 for prohibit sales */
				$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->CreditAvailable -= round(($NewItemQty * $Price * (1- $Discount)),$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->CurrDecimalPlaces);

				if ($_SESSION['CheckCreditLimits']==1 AND $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->CreditAvailable <=0){
					prnMsg(__('The customer account will breach their credit limit'),'warn');
					$AlreadyWarnedAboutCredit = true;
				} elseif ($_SESSION['CheckCreditLimits']==2 AND $_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->CreditAvailable <=0){
					prnMsg(__('No more lines can be added to this order the customer account is currently at or over their credit limit'),'warn');
					$WithinCreditLimit = false;
					$AlreadyWarnedAboutCredit = true;
				}
			}


			if ($WithinCreditLimit == true){
				$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]->add_to_cart ($NewItem,
															$NewItemQty,
															$MyItemRow['description'],
															$MyItemRow['longdescription'],
															$Price,
															$Discount,
															$MyItemRow['units'],
															$MyItemRow['volume'],
															$MyItemRow['grossweight'],
															$MyItemRow['quantity'],
															$MyItemRow['mbflag'],
															NULL, /*Actual Dispatch Date */
															0, /*Qty Invoiced */
															$MyItemRow['discountcategory'],
															0, /*Controlled - dont care */
															$MyItemRow['serialised'], /* need to know for autocreation wos */
															$MyItemRow['decimalplaces'],
															'', /*Narrative - none yet */
															$UpdateDB,
															$NewLineNo,
															$MyItemRow['taxcatid'],
															'',
															$NewItemDue,
															$NewPOLine,
															$MyItemRow['standardcost'],
															$MyItemRow['eoq'],
															$MyItemRow['nextserialno'],
															$ExRate,
															$identifier);

			}
         } else {
			prnMsg(__('The item code') . ' ' . $NewItem . ' ' . __('does not have a cost set up and order entry is set up to prohibit sales of items with no cost data entered'),'warn');
	     }
	}
} /* end of if not already on the order */

	$SQL="SELECT confvalue FROM config WHERE confname='DefaultDateFormat'";

	$DateFormat=$MyRow[0];
	if (mb_strstr($orddate,"/")) {

		$DateArray = explode('.',$orddate);
	}

		$Day=$DateArray[0];

	}
	return $Errors;

/** Check that the item due date is a valid date. The date
 * must be in the same format as the date format specified in the
 * target webERP company */
function VerifyItemDueDate($ItemDue, $i, $Errors) {
	$SQL="SELECT confvalue FROM config WHERE confname='DefaultDateFormat'";
	$Result=api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$DateFormat=$MyRow[0];
	if (mb_strstr($ItemDue,'/')) {
		$DateArray = explode('/',$ItemDue);
	} elseif (mb_strstr($PeriodEnd,'.')) {
		$DateArray = explode('.',$ItemDue);
	}
	if ($DateFormat=='d/m/Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='m/d/Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[1];
		$Month=$DateArray[0];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='Y/m/d') {
		$Day=$DateArray[2];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[0];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='d.m.Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	}
	if (!checkdate(intval($Month), intval($Day), intval($Year))) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidItemDueDate;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,

								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

		}

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']==1 AND $StandardCost !=0){

/*first the cost of sales entry - GL accounts are retrieved using the function GetCOGSGLAccount from includes/GetSalesTransGLCodes.php  */

										typeno,

									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . GetCOGSGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']) . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . ($StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*now the stock entry - this is set to the cost act in the case of a fixed asset disposal */
			$StockGLCode = GetStockGLCode($OrderLineRow['stkcode']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,

								VALUES (10,

			$SalesGLAccounts = GetSalesGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']);

					'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',

			if ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] !=0){

											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount)
						VALUES (10,
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $SalesGLAccounts['discountglcode'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " @ " . ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * 100) . "%',
							'" . ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['discountpercent']/$OrderHeader['rate']) . "')";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /*end of if discount !=0 */

		} /*end of if sales integrated with gl */

		$LineCounter++; //needed for the array of taxes by line
	} /*end of OrderLine loop */

	$TotalInvLocalCurr = ($TotalFXNetInvoice + $TotalFXTax)/$OrderHeader['rate'];

	if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1){

		/*Now post the tax to the GL at local currency equivalent */
		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $TaxAuthAmount !=0) {

			/*Loop through the tax authorities array to post each total to the taxauth glcode */
			foreach ($TaxTotals as $Tax){
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,

											narrative,
											amount )
										VALUES (10,
										'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
										'" . $OrderHeader['orddate']. "',
										'" . $PeriodNo . "',
										'" . $Tax['GLCode'] . "',

		if (($TotalInvLocalCurr) !=0) {

									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',

									'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(10,$InvoiceNo);

	} /*end of if Sales and GL integrated */

/*Update order header for invoice charged on */
	$SQL = "UPDATE salesorders SET comments = CONCAT(comments,' Inv ','" . $InvoiceNo . "') WHERE orderno= '" . $OrderNo . "'";

/*Now insert the DebtorTrans */

									'" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "',

									'" . $TotalFXNetInvoice . "',
									'" . $TotalFXTax . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['shipvia'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['salesman'] . "')";

	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id');

	/*for each Tax - need to insert into debtortranstaxes */
	foreach ($TaxTotals AS $TaxAuthID => $Tax) {

		$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortranstaxes (debtortransid,
											taxauthid,

							VALUES ('" . $DebtorTransID . "',

									'" . $Tax['FXAmount']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "')";

	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {

		DB_Txn_Commit();
		$Errors[0]=0;
		$Errors[1]=$InvoiceNo;
	} else {

	}
	return $Errors;

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}
