function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,
								1,
								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

/** This function takes a debtorno and returns an associative array containing
   the database record for that debtor. If the debtor number doesn't exist
   then it returns an $Errors array.
*/
function GetCustomer($DebtorNumber, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors = VerifyDebtorExists($DebtorNumber, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL="SELECT * FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='".$DebtorNumber."'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Errors[0] = 0; // None found.
	$Errors[1] = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	return $Errors;
}

/** This function takes a field name, and a string, and then returns an
   array of debtornos that fulfill this criteria.
*/
function SearchCustomers($Field, $Criteria, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL='SELECT debtorno
		FROM debtorsmaster
		WHERE '.$Field." LIKE '%".$Criteria."%'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$DebtorList = array(0);	    // First element: no errors
	while ($MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$DebtorList[]=$MyRow[0];
	}
	return $DebtorList;
}

<?php

 include('AuditScriptsFunctions.php');
 
/* Performs login checks and $_SESSION initialisation */

define('UL_OK',  0);		/* User verified, session initialised */
define('UL_NOTVALID', 1);	/* User/password do not agree */
define('UL_BLOCKED', 2);	/* Account locked, too many failed logins */
define('UL_CONFIGERR', 3);	/* Configuration error in webERP or server */
define('UL_SHOWLOGIN', 4);
define('UL_MAINTENANCE', 5);

/*
 *  Function to validate username and password, perform validity checks and initialise $_SESSION data.
 *  @returns int See define() statements above.
 */
function userLogin($Name, $Password, $SysAdminEmail = '') {

	global $PathPrefix;

	if (!isset($_SESSION['AccessLevel']) OR $_SESSION['AccessLevel'] == '' OR
		(isset($Name) AND $Name != '')) {

		/* Log the script we run so we can optimize CPU time*/	
		$_SESSION['ScriptStartTime'] = microtime();
		
		/* if not logged in */

		$_SESSION['AccessLevel'] = '';
		$_SESSION['CustomerID'] = '';
		$_SESSION['UserBranch'] = '';
		$_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] = '';
		$_SESSION['Module'] = '';
		$_SESSION['PageSize'] = '';
		$_SESSION['UserStockLocation'] = '';
		$_SESSION['AttemptsCounter']++;

		if (!isset($Name) or $Name == '') {
			// Show login screen
			$_SESSION['DatabaseName'] = '';
			return  UL_SHOWLOGIN;
		}

		/* The SQL to get the user info must use the * syntax because the field name could change between versions if the fields are specifed directly then the sql fails and the db upgrade will fail */
		$SQL = "SELECT *
				FROM www_users
				WHERE www_users.userid='" . $Name . "'";

		$ErrMsg = __('Could not retrieve user details on login because');
        $PasswordVerified = false;
		$Auth_Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg);

		if (DB_num_rows($Auth_Result) > 0) {
			$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Auth_Result);
			if (VerifyPass($Password, $MyRow['password'])) {
				$PasswordVerified = true;
			} elseif (isset($GLOBALS['CryptFunction'])) {
				/*if the password stored in the DB was compiled the old way,
				 * the previous comparison will fail,
				 * try again with the old hashing algorithm,
				 * then re-hash the password using the new algorithm.
				 * The next version should not have $CryptFunction any more for new installs.
				 */
				switch ($GLOBALS['CryptFunction']) {
					case 'sha1':
						if ($MyRow['password'] == sha1($Password)) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}
						break;
					case 'md5':
						if ($MyRow['password'] == md5($Password)) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if ($MyRow['password'] == $Password) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}
				}
				if ($PasswordVerified) {
					$SQL = "UPDATE www_users SET password = '" . CryptPass($Password) . "'"
							. " WHERE userid = '" . $Name . "';";
					DB_query($SQL);
				}
			}
		}

		// Populate session variables with database results
		if ($PasswordVerified) {

			if ($MyRow['blocked']==1) {
				//the account is blocked
				unset($_POST['UserNameEntryField']);
				unset($_POST['Password']);
				unset($_SESSION['DatabaseName']);

				// log the script running time
				RecordRunningTime('Login attempt on blocked account', $Name); 
				return  UL_BLOCKED;
			}

			/*reset the attempts counter on successful login */
			$_SESSION['UserID'] = $MyRow['userid'];
			$_SESSION['AttemptsCounter'] = 0;
			$_SESSION['AccessLevel'] = $MyRow['fullaccess'];
			$_SESSION['CustomerID'] = $MyRow['customerid'];
			$_SESSION['UserBranch'] = $MyRow['branchcode'];
			$_SESSION['PageSize'] = $MyRow['pagesize'];
			$_SESSION['UserStockLocation'] = $MyRow['defaultlocation'];
			$_SESSION['UserEmail'] = $MyRow['email'];
			$_SESSION['Timeout'] = $MyRow['timeout'];
			$_SESSION['ModulesEnabled'] = explode(",", $MyRow['modulesallowed']);
			$_SESSION['UsersRealName'] = $MyRow['realname'];
			$_SESSION['Theme'] = $MyRow['theme'];
			$_SESSION['Language'] = $MyRow['language'];
			$_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] = $MyRow['salesman'];
			$_SESSION['CanCreateTender'] = $MyRow['cancreatetender'];
			$_SESSION['AllowedDepartment'] = $MyRow['department'];
			$_SESSION['ShowDashboard'] = $MyRow['showdashboard'];
			$_SESSION['ShowPageHelp'] = $MyRow['showpagehelp'];
			$_SESSION['ShowFieldHelp'] = $MyRow['showfieldhelp'];
			$_SESSION['ScreenFontSize'] = $MyRow['fontsize'];

			$_SESSION['FontSize'] = match ($_SESSION['ScreenFontSize']) {
				'0'       => '0.667rem',
				'1'       => '0.833rem',
				'2'       => '1rem',
				default => '0.833rem',
			};

			if (isset($MyRow['pdflanguage'])) {
				$_SESSION['PDFLanguage'] = $MyRow['pdflanguage'];
			} else {
				$_SESSION['PDFLanguage'] = '0'; //default to latin western languages
			}

			if ($MyRow['displayrecordsmax'] > 0) {
				$_SESSION['DisplayRecordsMax'] = $MyRow['displayrecordsmax'];
			} else {
				$_SESSION['DisplayRecordsMax'] = $_SESSION['DefaultDisplayRecordsMax'];  // default comes from config.php
			}

			/// @todo should we not update this for API logins?
			$SQL = "UPDATE www_users SET lastvisitdate='". date('Y-m-d H:i:s') ."'
							WHERE www_users.userid='" . $Name . "'";
			$Auth_Result = DB_query($SQL);
			/*get the security tokens that the user has access to */
			$SQL = "SELECT tokenid
					FROM securitygroups
					WHERE secroleid =  '" . $_SESSION['AccessLevel'] . "'";
			$Sec_Result = DB_query($SQL);
			$_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'] = array();
			if (DB_num_rows($Sec_Result)==0) {
				// log the script running time
				RecordRunningTime('Login attempt with security tokens error', $_SESSION['UserID']); 
				return  UL_CONFIGERR;
			} else {
				$i = 0;
				while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Sec_Result)) {
					$_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'][$i] = $MyRow[0];
					$i++;
				}
			}

			/* User is logged in so get configuration parameters - save in session */
			include($PathPrefix . 'includes/GetConfig.php');

			if (isset($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance'])) {
				if ($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance']>0)  { //run the DB maintenance script
					if (DateDiff(Date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']),
							ConvertSQLDate($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance_LastRun'])
							,'d')	>= 	$_SESSION['DB_Maintenance']) {

						/*Do the DB maintenance routing for the DB_type selected */
						DB_Maintenance();
						$_SESSION['DB_Maintenance_LastRun'] = Date('Y-m-d');

						/* Audit trail purge only runs if DB_Maintenance is enabled */
						if (isset($_SESSION['MonthsAuditTrail'])) {
							 $SQL = "DELETE FROM audittrail
									WHERE  transactiondate <= '" . Date('Y-m-d', mktime(0,0,0, Date('m')-$_SESSION['MonthsAuditTrail'])) . "'";
							$ErrMsg = __('There was a problem deleting expired audit-trail history');
							DB_query($SQL);

							 $SQL = "DELETE FROM auditscripts
									WHERE  executiondate <= '" . Date('Y-m-d', mktime(0,0,0, Date('m')-$_SESSION['MonthsAuditTrail'])) . "'";
							$ErrMsg = __('There was a problem deleting expired audit-script history');
							DB_query($SQL);

						}
					}
				}
			}

			/*Check to see if currency rates need to be updated */
			if (isset($_SESSION['UpdateCurrencyRatesDaily']) and $_SESSION['UpdateCurrencyRatesDaily']!=0)  {
				/* Only run the update to currency rates if today is after the last update i.e. only runs once a day */
				if (DateDiff(Date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']),
					ConvertSQLDate($_SESSION['UpdateCurrencyRatesDaily']),'d')> 0) {

					include($PathPrefix . 'includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');

					if ($_SESSION['ExchangeRateFeed']=='ECB') {
						$CurrencyRates = GetECBCurrencyRates(); // gets rates from ECB see includes/MiscFunctions.php
						/*Loop around the defined currencies and get the rate from ECB */
						if ($CurrencyRates!=false) {
							$CurrenciesResult = DB_query("SELECT currabrev, rate FROM currencies");
							while ($CurrencyRow = DB_fetch_row($CurrenciesResult)){
								if ($CurrencyRow[0]!=$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']){
									$NewRate = GetCurrencyRate($CurrencyRow[0],$CurrencyRates);
									if ($NewRate == '') {
										$NewRate = 1;
									}
									DB_query("UPDATE currencies
											SET rate='" . $NewRate . "'
											WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrencyRow[0] . "'");
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						$CurrenciesResult = DB_query("SELECT currabrev, rate FROM currencies");
						while ($CurrencyRow = DB_fetch_row($CurrenciesResult)){
							if ($CurrencyRow[0]!=$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']){
								if ($_SESSION['ExchangeRateFeed'] == 'DXR') {
									$CurrencyRatesArray = GetDXRCurrencyRates();
								} else {
									$CurrencyRatesArray = array();
								}
								$NewRate = GetCurrencyRate($CurrencyRow[0], $CurrencyRatesArray);
								DB_query("UPDATE currencies
											SET rate='" . $NewRate . "'
											WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrencyRow[0] . "'");
							}
						}
					}
					$_SESSION['UpdateCurrencyRatesDaily'] = Date('Y-m-d');
					DB_query("UPDATE config
							SET confvalue = CURRENT_DATE
							WHERE confname='UpdateCurrencyRatesDaily'");
				}
			}

			/* Set the logo if not yet set.
			 * will be done only once per session and each time
			 * we are not in session (i.e. before login)
			 */
			if (empty($_SESSION['LogoFile'])) {
				/* find a logo in companies/CompanyDir */
				if (file_exists($PathPrefix . 'companies/' . $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.png')) {
					$_SESSION['LogoFile'] = 'companies/' .  $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.png';
				} elseif (file_exists($PathPrefix . 'companies/' . $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.jpeg')) {

				 */
				switch ($GLOBALS['CryptFunction']) {
					case 'sha1':
						if ($MyRow['password'] == sha1($Password)) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}
						break;
					case 'md5':
						if ($MyRow['password'] == md5($Password)) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}
						break;
					default:
						if ($MyRow['password'] == $Password) {
							$PasswordVerified = true;
						}

					$SQL = "UPDATE www_users SET password = '" . CryptPass($Password) . "'"
							. " WHERE userid = '" . $Name . "';";

			$Auth_Result = DB_query($SQL);

							ConvertSQLDate($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance_LastRun'])

				}

			/* Set the logo if not yet set.

			if (empty($_SESSION['LogoFile'])) {

				if (file_exists($PathPrefix . 'companies/' . $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.png')) {

					$_SESSION['LogoFile'] = 'companies/' .  $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.jpg';

					$_SESSION['LogoFile'] = 'companies/' .  $_SESSION['DatabaseName'] . '/logo.gif';
				}
			}

			if (!isset($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance'])) {
				// log the script running time

				return  UL_CONFIGERR;
			} else {
				if ($_SESSION['DB_Maintenance']==-1 AND !in_array(15, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])) {
					// the configuration setting has been set to -1 ==> Allow SysAdmin Access Only
					// the user is NOT a SysAdmin
					// log the script running time
					RecordRunningTime('Login attempt while on maintenance mode', $_SESSION['UserID']);

		} else {

			return  UL_NOTVALID;

input.content:
Credit Control

Overview

Credit control applies the same rules to every customer every time, and keeps a record of every decision: who made it, when and why. It covers credit reviews, stopping and watching customers, overdue reminder letters, month end interest and late fees, bad debt write-offs and the credit control report. Everything is found in the Accounts Receivable menu (Transactions, Reports and Maintenance) and nothing needs to be done outside webERP except the collection of debts by agencies or lawyers, which can be noted against the customer.

Who can do what is controlled by two security tokens, given to user roles in User Roles Maintenance:

  • Credit Control - the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director. Only these users can change credit limits and credit status, run reminders and month end charges, and request write-offs. Sales reps and the sales office cannot.
  • Credit Control Write-off Approval - the Finance Director. Write-offs above the amount set by Finance wait for this approval. Nobody can approve a write-off they asked for themselves.

Credit Control Settings

Finance sets, in Accounts Receivable > Maintenance > Credit Control Settings: the standard review period in months (new customers get their first review date from it), the interest rate per year, the late fee per month (in the home currency, converted to the customer's currency), the number of days overdue before a balance is charged, the general ledger accounts that interest and fees are posted to, the bad debt account, the amount above which write-offs need approval, the minimum number of days between two reminders to the same customer, and whether a customer is put on stop automatically after the final notice.

The wording and timing of the reminder letters is set in Reminder Letter Stages: any number of stages, the days overdue that trigger each, and the text in each language (customers whose language has no text get the English one). In the text {name} {invoices} {currency} {amount} {company} {date} are replaced when the letter is made.

Credit reviews

Every customer on account has a next review date. Use Credit Review to record a review: the new credit limit, the credit status, the notes and the next review date. The credit limit changes at the same time as the review is recorded, so the limit and the reason for it are always kept together. The outcome (limit confirmed, raised, reduced, put on watch, put on stop, taken off stop) follows from what was changed. Reviews can never be changed or deleted, the history of reviews is shown on the same page. In the same page invoices can be marked as disputed - they are then not chased by reminders and not charged interest until the dispute is settled - and customers can be exempted from interest and/or fees. A note can be added at any time, for example to record that a debt has been passed to a collection agency.

Stop and watch

A customer's credit status is one of the credit statuses set up in Credit Status Code Maintenance. A status marked Disallow Invoices is on stop, any other status is normal; statuses defined with the value 2 for disallow invoices (customers to be watched) show a warning. To put a customer on stop or on watch, or to take them off, record a credit review with the status and the reason.

  • On stop: no orders can be accepted by any route - the sales office, the customer in the web shop, electronic orders and standing orders - and nothing is dispatched or invoiced on orders taken earlier unless credit control releases the order in Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control. A customer in the web shop is told that the account is on hold.
  • On watch: the customer is still supplied, but whoever takes an order sees a warning, and credit control sees the orders in Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control. Customers are not shown that they are on watch.
  • The credit status is shown on the customer inquiry and account screens, and in the aged debtors report together with the credit limit and the last reminder stage sent.
  • Orders that take a customer over the credit limit are held for credit control approval when Check Credit Limits in the system parameters is set to Hold order for credit control approval. They are released in Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control.

The reminder run

Credit control starts Overdue Reminder Run regularly, for example every week. It first shows which customers would get which letter, to whom it would be emailed and the overdue amount. Untick the customers who must not be chased in this run - for example where a payment has been promised - and send. Letters are emailed to the customer's statement contacts (the contacts ticked for statements). Customers with no email address are listed with the text of the letter so that it can be posted.

A customer only moves up a stage if they still have overdue invoices, so a customer who has paid gets nothing, and the same stage is not sent twice, nor any letter within the minimum number of days after the last one. Disputed invoices are not chased. Every letter sent is recorded against the customer with the date, the stage, the invoices and the amount, and customers can see their letters in the customer portal.

Month end interest and late fees

At month end open Month End Interest and Late Fees, choose the month and look at the list of what will be charged to whom. Untick any customer you do not want to charge and confirm. Interest is simple interest at the yearly rate on the balance that is overdue by at least the number of days set by Finance, for the number of days in the month; unallocated receipts and credits reduce that balance. Interest is not charged on late fees or interest. The late fee is charged once per customer per month. Exempt customers and disputed invoices are left out. Charges are entered in the customer's own currency as separate items (Late Payment Interest and Late Payment Fee) that show on the customer account, the next statement and in the portal, and are posted to the general ledger. A month is never charged twice to the same customer. A charge can be waived with a reason from the same screen; the waiver reverses the charge in the customer account and in the ledger.

Bad debt write-offs

Use Bad Debt Write-offs (or the link in Credit Review) to write off all or part of a customer's balance with a reason. A write-off below the approval amount is posted at once; a larger one waits in the list for the Finance Director to approve or reject it, and nothing is posted until then. A posted write-off reduces the customer's open invoices, oldest first, and is posted to debtors control and the bad debt account; any difference between the exchange rate of the invoices and the rate of the write-off goes to the exchange difference account. The customer is put on stop unless the option is cleared. The same page reports the write-offs in a period: customer, amount, reason, who asked and who approved. When a debt that was written off is paid later, enter the receipt as usual: it appears as an unallocated receipt on the account.

Credit control report

The report lists customers due or overdue for a credit review, customers over their credit limit and by how much, and customers on watch or on stop. It can be filtered by sales rep and currency, and the totals are in the home currency. Sales reps only see their own customers. Credit Control History shows everything that has happened to one customer: reviews, status and limit changes, reminders, charges, waivers and write-offs.

Month end reconciliation

At month end the total of the customer balances must agree with the debtors control account. Debtors Control Integrity (special utilities) now includes interest, fees, waivers and write-offs, and where the two disagree it lists the customer account entries that have no posting to the control account and the postings to the control account that are not in any customer account.

Going live

When the update is applied every existing customer keeps their balances and history, starts as normal with a next review date 12 months ahead, and over-limit orders begin to be held. Use Import Customer Credit Status from .csv file to load the stop list, the credit limits and the review dates from the credit controller's spreadsheet: customer code, status (normal, watch or stop), credit limit, next review date as YYYY-MM-DD and a note. The file is checked first and only loaded when the confirm box is ticked.

A note for sales staff

On watch means we still supply the customer, but you will see a warning when you take an order for them. Talk to the customer, and tell credit control about the order if you are worried. On stop means no orders can be taken for the customer by anybody. You can see the reason; you cannot change it. Do not promise delivery - contact credit control, who decide whether to release orders. Over-limit orders are accepted but held until credit control approves them. You can see the credit information of your own customers only.

Credit Control

Overview

Credit control applies the same rules to every customer every time, and keeps a record of every decision: who made it, when and why. It covers credit reviews, stopping and watching customers, overdue reminder letters, month end interest and late fees, bad debt write-offs and the credit control report. Everything is found in the Accounts Receivable menu (Transactions, Reports and Maintenance) and nothing needs to be done outside webERP except the collection of debts by agencies or lawyers, which can be noted against the customer.

Who can do what is controlled by two security tokens, given to user roles in User Roles Maintenance:

  • Credit Control - the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director. Only these users can change credit limits and credit status, run reminders and month end charges, and request write-offs. Sales reps and the sales office cannot.
  • Credit Control Write-off Approval - the Finance Director. Write-offs above the amount set by Finance wait for this approval. Nobody can approve a write-off they asked for themselves.

Credit Control Settings

Finance sets, in Accounts Receivable > Maintenance > Credit Control Settings: the standard review period in months (new customers get their first review date from it), the interest rate per year, the late fee per month (in the home currency, converted to the customer's currency), the number of days overdue before a balance is charged, the general ledger accounts that interest and fees are posted to, the bad debt account, the amount above which write-offs need approval, the minimum number of days between two reminders to the same customer, and whether a customer is put on stop automatically after the final notice.

The wording and timing of the reminder letters is set in Reminder Letter Stages: any number of stages, the days overdue that trigger each, and the text in each language (customers whose language has no text get the English one).   • On watch: the customer is still supplied, but whoever takes an order sees a warning, and credit control sees the orders in Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control. Customers are not shown that they are on watch.
  • The credit status is shown on the customer inquiry and account screens, and in the aged debtors report together with the credit limit and the last reminder stage sent.
  • Orders that take a customer over the credit limit are held for credit control approval when Check Credit Limits in the system parameters is set to Hold order for credit control approval. They are released in Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control.

<?php

// CREDIT CONTROL
//
// Credit status is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason (holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 = stop, 2 = watch).
// This update adds what is needed around it: review dates, review and action history, reminder letters,
// late interest and fees, write-offs and the permissions to run them.

// 1. Existing tables

AddColumn('nextreviewdate', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextreviewdate');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');
AddIndex(array('nextreviewdate'), 'debtorsmaster', 'nextreviewdate');

AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'salesperson');

AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');
AddIndex(array('creditheld'), 'salesorders', 'creditheld');

// 2. New tables

CreateTable('creditreviews', "CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `reviewid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `oldholdreason` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newholdreason` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `entered` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`reviewid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditreviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditlog', "CREATE TABLE `creditlog` (
  `logid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `eventtype` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reference` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`logid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `eventtype` (`eventtype`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditlog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages', "CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `finalnotice` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`stageno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningtexts', "CREATE TABLE `dunningtexts` (
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `language_id` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_GB.utf8',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`stageno`,`language_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunningtexts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`stageno`) REFERENCES `dunningstages` (`stageno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunninglog', "CREATE TABLE `dunninglog` (
  `dunningid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stageno` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `senddate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `invoices` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `emailto` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `letter` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dunningid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`,`stageno`),
  KEY `senddate` (`senddate`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunninglog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditcharges', "CREATE TABLE `creditcharges` (
  `chargeid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'interest',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `basis` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `trandate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `waived` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivetransno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `waivedate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `waivereason` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`chargeid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `debtormonthtype` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `chargemonth` (`chargemonth`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditcharges_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditwriteoffs', "CREATE TABLE `creditwriteoffs` (
  `writeoffid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requestdate` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approvedate` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `stopcustomer` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`writeoffid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditwriteoffs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

// 3. Transaction types for the customer account entries

NewSysType(51, 'Late Payment Interest');
NewSysType(52, 'Late Payment Fee');
NewSysType(53, 'Late Charge Waiver');
NewSysType(54, 'Bad Debt Write-off');

// 4. Security: new tokens, who gets them, pages, menu

NewSecurityToken(21, 'Credit Control');
NewSecurityToken(22, 'Credit Control Write-off Approval');

// Accountant and System Administrator can do credit control, only the System Administrator role approves write-offs
// until the Finance Director's own role is given token 22 in User Roles Maintenance
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(6, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 21));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array(8, 22));

NewScript('CreditReview.php', 21);
NewScript('DunningRun.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditCharges.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditWriteOffs.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditHeldOrders.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlReport.php', 2);
NewScript('CreditHistory.php', 1);
NewScript('CreditControlSettings.php', 10);
NewScript('DunningStages.php', 10);
NewScript('Z_ImportCreditStatus.php', 15);

// function NewMenuItem($Link, $Section, $Caption, $URL, $Sequence)
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Credit Review'), '/CreditReview.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Overdue Reminder Run'), '/DunningRun.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Month End Interest and Late Fees'), '/CreditCharges.php', 22);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Bad Debt Write-offs'), '/CreditWriteOffs.php', 23);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Orders Held or On Watch for Credit Control'), '/CreditHeldOrders.php', 24);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Report'), '/CreditControlReport.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control History'), '/CreditHistory.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Credit Control Settings'), '/CreditControlSettings.php', 20);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Reminder Letter Stages'), '/DunningStages.php', 21);
NewMenuItem('Utilities', 'Maintenance', __('Import Customer Credit Status from .csv file'), '/Z_ImportCreditStatus.php', 45);

// 5. Configuration, Finance completes the general ledger accounts in Credit Control Settings

NewConfigValue('CreditReviewMonths', '12');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestRate', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditLateFee', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditChargeDays', '30');
NewConfigValue('CreditInterestAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditFeeAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditBadDebtAccount', '');
NewConfigValue('CreditWriteOffThreshold', '1000');
NewConfigValue('CreditReminderGapDays', '14');
NewConfigValue('CreditAutoStopAfterFinal', '0');
NewConfigValue('CreditStopHoldReason', '');

// 6. Data

// Hold reasons created with the column default (-1) never blocked anybody in order entry, keep that behaviour
executeSQL("UPDATE holdreasons SET dissallowinvoices=0 WHERE dissallowinvoices<0");

// The business wants over-limit orders held for approval: "do not check" and "warn" become "hold for approval"
// "prohibit" is stricter and stays as it is
executeSQL("UPDATE config SET confvalue='3' WHERE confname='CheckCreditLimits' AND confvalue IN ('0','1')");

// Every existing customer starts with a next review date, Finance can change them or load them from the old spreadsheet
// with Z_ImportCreditStatus.php
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextreviewdate='1000-01-01'");

// Reminder letters: three stages to start with
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(1), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(1, 30, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(2), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(2, 45, 0));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stageno'), array(3), array('stageno', 'daysoverdue', 'finalnotice'), array(3, 60, 1));

InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(1, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nOur records show that the following invoices on your account are overdue. This may be an oversight, if you have already paid please ignore this reminder.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease arrange payment at your earliest convenience.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(2, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'Second reminder: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nWe wrote to you recently about overdue invoices on your account and have not yet received payment. The following invoices remain unpaid.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nPlease pay immediately or contact us to discuss.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));
InsertRecord('dunningtexts', array('stageno', 'language_id'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8'), array('stageno', 'language_id', 'subject', 'body'), array(3, 'en_GB.utf8',
	'FINAL NOTICE: overdue account',
	"Dear {name},\n\nDespite our earlier reminders the following invoices remain unpaid.\n\n{invoices}\nTotal overdue: {currency} {amount}\n\nUnless payment is received within 7 days your account will be put on stop, no further orders will be supplied and late payment interest and fees will be charged.\n\nKind regards,\n{company}"));

UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control'));

# Credit control - what was built and why

Nothing could be run here (no PHP, no database), so none of this has been executed. It was written against the existing code and
checked by reading. Run update 44 on a copy of the live database and walk through AC-01 to AC-12 before it goes live.

## The main finding: webERP already has a stop mechanism

`debtorsmaster.holdreason` -> `holdreasons.dissallowinvoices` is already webERP's credit status (1 = no invoicing, 2 = "watch" in
`SelectOrderItems.php`, 0 = fine). So stop and watch are built **on that**, not as a second flag:

* normal / watch / stop = the hold reason of the customer, by its `dissallowinvoices` value (0 / 2 / 1).
* `CreditStatus.php` could only create 0 or 1, so "watch" could not be configured. It is now a three-way choice (normal, watch, stop).
* The demo data had hold reasons with the column default `-1`, which blocked nobody. Update 44 sets these to 0 (what they did in practice);
  `demo.sql` gives them sensible values.
* Only the first order-entry screen checked the status, and a stopped customer could still end up selected. Nothing checked at order
  commit, in the standing-order process, EDI, the API, or on dispatch/invoicing. Those are now covered (below).

## What was built

**Schema** (`sql/updates/44.php`, plus `install/sql/tables/*.sql`, `install/sql/data/*.sql` and `install/sql/demo.sql` so that fresh
installs and the demo company get the same, because the installer writes the highest update number without running the updates)

* `debtorsmaster`: `nextreviewdate`, `interestexempt`, `feeexempt`. `debtortrans`: `disputed`. `salesorders`: `creditheld` (0 none, 1 held, 2 released).
* New tables: `creditreviews` (immutable review history), `creditlog` (audit trail of everything, no FK so it outlives a customer),
  `dunningstages`, `dunningtexts` (wording per stage and language), `dunninglog` (letters sent), `creditcharges` (interest/fee per customer
  per month, unique on customer+month+type so a month is never charged twice), `creditwriteoffs` (requests and approvals).
* New transaction types 51 Late Payment Interest, 52 Late Payment Fee, 53 Late Charge Waiver, 54 Bad Debt Write-off. Interest and fee are
  separate types so they print as separate, clearly named lines on the existing statement, account inquiry and portal without touching those pages.
* New security tokens 21 *Credit Control* (Accountant and System Administrator roles by default) and 22 *Write-off Approval* (System
  Administrator only; give it to the Finance Director's role). New pages, menu items and config keys (`Credit*`) in update, install data and demo.
* Migration: every customer gets a next review date 12 months out; `CheckCreditLimits` 0 or 1 becomes the new value 3 (hold for approval);
  three default reminder stages (30/45/60 days, last one is the final notice).

**Shared code**: `includes/CreditControlFunctions.php` - status, `CreditOrderCheck()` (the one rule used by every order route), overdue items
(due date follows payment terms exactly like the aged debtors report), history log, ledger posting, allocation with exchange difference.

**Pages** (all in the AR menu): `CreditReview.php` (review, limit, status, next date, exemptions, disputed items, notes - the only place a
limit or status changes), `CreditHistory.php`, `CreditControlReport.php`, `DunningRun.php`, `DunningStages.php`, `CreditCharges.php`
(preview, confirm, waive), `CreditWriteOffs.php` (request, approve, report), `CreditHeldOrders.php`, `CreditControlSettings.php`,
`Z_ImportCreditStatus.php` (go-live load of the spreadsheet stop list; checks first, loads on confirm).

**Changes to existing code**

* Order routes: `DeliveryDetails.php` (blocks a stopped customer, holds an over-limit order; covers sales office and the customer in the web shop),
  `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` (stopped customers are skipped and picked up after release; over-limit orders held and not auto-invoiced),
  `EDIProcessOrders.php` (rejected, reported in the usual email), `api/includes/api_salesorders.php` (header and invoicing).
* `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php`: nothing is dispatched or invoiced for a stopped customer or a held order unless released in `CreditHeldOrders.php`.
* `Customers.php`, `api_customers.php`, `Z_ImportDebtors.php`: limit and status can no longer be edited there (they were open to anyone who can
  edit a customer); opening limit/status only for token 21, otherwise default limit and a normal status; new customers get a review date.
* **Portal security hole fixed**: `CustomerInquiry.php` and `CustomerAccount.php` let any logged-in user see any customer by changing `CustomerID` in the
  address. A portal user is now pinned to their own customer. `$_SESSION['CustomerID']` is also used for "customer currently selected" by staff, so
  `LoginFunctions.php` now keeps `LoginCustomerID` separately. Sessions started before the update must log in again (they see nothing until then).
* Reconciliation: `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php` only counted types 10/11/12, so interest, fees and write-offs would have shown as differences. Fixed,
  an old bug in its difference total fixed, and it now lists entries missing from the ledger and ledger entries missing from customer accounts (BR-38).
  `CustomerBalancesMovement.php` and `DebtorsAtPeriodEnd.php` also classified by type and now know the new types.
* `AgedDebtors.php`: status, limit and last reminder stage. `CustomerInquiry/CustomerAccount`: stop/watch banner. `SystemParameters.php`:
  new "Hold order for credit control approval" option. `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` and the customer delete check know the new tables.
* Documentation: `doc/Manual/ManualCreditControl.html` (staff guide incl. the note for sales staff) and its entry in `ManualOutline.php`.

## Decisions on the open questions

1. Interest: simple annual rate, one rate, on the balance overdue by at least the configured days, for the days in the month. No per-currency rate.
2. Late fee: one flat fee per customer per month, set in home currency and converted at the current rate.
3. No interest on interest/fees (late charges are excluded from the base). Unallocated receipts and credits reduce the base.
4. After the final notice: flag only by default; a setting turns on automatic stop.
5. Over-limit orders from every route are held for approval, not rejected.
6. Threshold is a setting (home currency); no Financial Accountant sign-off, but whoever approves cannot be whoever requested.
7. A written-off debt later paid is entered as a normal receipt and shows as an unallocated receipt; no automatic "recovery" posting.
8. Reps and the sales office see the reason for a stop or watch. Customers see "on hold" for a stop, never the watch status (portal, inquiry and account).
9. Letter wording is per language with English fallback.
10. Watch is not shown in the portal. 11. Anyone holding token 21 can cover; nothing special for "both away".
12. Credit limit is per customer account (webERP has no head-office/branch limit group; branches sit under one customer account and share its limit).

## Other choices and known limits

* Credit history (`CreditHistory.php`): full audit trail for token 21 or token 8 (GL inquiries - the auditors); reps get status, limit, balance, reminders and
  charges for their own customers; customers only reminders, charges and balance. The credit control report is filtered the same way.
* Over-limit hold through the API is judged at order header time (lines come later), so it only catches a customer already at or over the limit.
* A waiver nets against the charge; if the customer had already paid the charge the waiver stays as an unallocated credit.
* A write-off is allocated to the oldest open items; it needs the open items to cover the amount (allocate receipts and credits first).
* Charges are not taxed. Interest is computed from current balances as at the charge date, not reconstructed historically.
* `EDIProcessOrders.php` still has its old `if ($CreateOrder = true)`; I only added the credit guard and did not change that behaviour.
* Not changed: counter sales and special orders keep their existing customer-level stop check.
* No translations (.po) were added for the new strings.

10. Watch is not shown in the portal. 11. Anyone holding token 21 can cover; nothing special for "both away".

content.text:
I built the credit control feature, but none of it has been run. There was no PHP or database in this environment, so I checked it by reading the code only. Before go-live, apply update 44 to a copy of the live database and walk through AC-01 to AC-12.

**Stop and watch build on what webERP already has.** A customer's credit status is the existing `holdreason`, and `holdreasons.dissallowinvoices` already means 1 = stop and 2 = watch. The existing Credit Status maintenance page could only create "normal" or "stop", so watch could never be set up. It now offers normal, watch and stop. The demo hold reasons had a default that blocked nobody; update 44 sets them to "normal" and the demo data gives them real values.

**Main pieces:**
- **Pages:** review, history, report, reminder run, reminder stages, month-end interest and fees (with waiver), write-offs with approval, held orders, settings, and a CSV import for the old stop list. They are in the AR menu.
- **Stop enforcement:** a stopped customer is blocked at order commit (sales office and web shop), standing orders, EDI and the API. Dispatch and invoicing are also blocked, unless credit control releases the order. Over-limit orders are held for approval.
- **Tokens:** new tokens 21 (credit control) and 22 (write-off approval) control who can do what. Nobody can approve their own write-off.
- **Ledger types:** interest, fee, waiver and write-off are new customer-account entry types (51 to 54). Interest and fees appear as separate lines on statements and in the portal.
- **Install and migration:** update 44 and matching changes to the install files and `demo.sql`, because the installer writes the latest update number without running the updates.
- **Docs:** a staff guide, including the note for sales staff, is in `doc/Manual/ManualCreditControl.html`.

**Other things that needed changing:**
- **Portal security hole fixed.** `CustomerInquiry.php` and `CustomerAccount.php` let any logged-in user view any customer by changing `CustomerID` in the address. Portal users are now pinned to their own customer. This needed a new `LoginCustomerID` session key, so sessions started before the update must log in again.
- **Credit edits closed off.** Customer maintenance, the API and the customer import no longer let anyone edit credit limit or status. Those changes now go through the review page only.
- **Reconciliation fixed.** `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php` only counted invoice, credit and receipt types, so interest, fees and write-offs would have shown as differences. It now includes them and lists the entries missing from either side. The balance-movement and prior-month-end reports also needed the new types.

**Behaviours that change on your live system:**
- Update 44 changes `CheckCreditLimits` from "do not check" or "warn" to the new "hold for approval". "Prohibit" is left as it is.
- Every existing customer gets a next review date 12 months out.

**Decisions I made on the open questions:** each is listed in `NOTES.md`. A few examples: simple annual interest with no interest on interest or fees; one flat late fee per customer per month; no automatic stop after the final notice unless a setting turns it on; over-limit orders are held, not rejected; and one credit limit per customer account.

**Known limits:**
- Over-limit hold through the API is judged when the order header is created, so it only catches a customer already at or over their limit.
- The staff guide says a customer is on stop if their status is marked "Disallow Invoices". Since I changed that screen, the wording there should be read as "On stop".
- No translation files were added for the new strings.

`NOTES.md` at the repository root has the full list of files changed and the other limits.
